items.title: The Two Basic Technologies of Genetic Engineering

source_refs.note: The two basic technologies of genetic engineering (PDF 155).

blocks.text: Genetic engineers rely on two basic technologies.

blocks.caption: The two basic technologies
rows: physically cuts a piece of DNA from one organism and 'pastes' it into the DNA of another
rapidly amplifies a tiny segment of DNA into a large quantity

blocks.title: Cut-and-paste and photocopy
blocks.text: Recombinant DNA technology is like cutting a sentence from one document and pasting it into another; PCR is like running one page through a photocopier again and again.

blocks.prompt: Which technology would you use to make millions of copies of a small DNA sample from a crime scene?
blocks.explanation: PCR, which amplifies a tiny segment of DNA into a large quantity.

items: Recombinant DNA: cut and paste DNA between organisms.
PCR: amplify a small piece of DNA.
